paragraphs: It is Job Day at school. The sun is hot. The class sits under a tree. Teacher Kim has a big board. "What do you want to be?" asks Teacher Kim. "I want to be a farmer," says Mia. "I love animals!" "I want to be a teacher," says Lily. "I want to be a clown!" says Leo. He has a red nose and a funny hat. The children clap.

Pip is at school today. He runs to Leo. He takes the funny hat. "Stop, Pip!" says Leo. Pip runs and runs. Leo runs behind him. The class runs, too. Pip stops under the tree. He puts the hat on his head. "Look!" says Mia. "Pip is a clown!"

Leo stops and looks at Pip. He smiles. "Well done, Pip!" says Leo. "You can have the hat." "Do you want to be a clown, too?" "Woof!" says Pip. Teacher Kim laughs and says yes. Teacher Kim writes on the board. She writes, "Pip is a clown." The children smile.
text.summary: On Job Day, the children say what they want to be. Pip takes Leo's clown hat, and the class runs after him.
